cs.t: On top of all of the other criticisms,  this isn’t functionally what I want.  I still would end up looking down to see the laptop. I guess it’s better for people who only work on laptops and don’t want to have separate keyboards and pointing devices. I travel a lot and I use a Roost laptop stand  https://www.therooststand.com/  A standard Apple keyboard and mouse, and a portable USB powered monitor that gets power and video from one USB cable and monitor stand  https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0C4KH2GH3
cs.th: A laptop stand made from a single sheet of recycled paper

cs.t: Roost Laptop stand + bluetooth keyboard and trackpad Enormous impact on my posture when I'm using my laptop away from my desk.  The stand collapses into a stick so it's easy to toss in my backpack.  https://www.therooststand.com/collections/roost-laptop-stand...
